angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 423,681 km at 151.81 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.5873 +/- 0.0194 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01): 151.81 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.609 +/- 0.016 solar radii from Hotnisky et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-6303 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract): 423,681 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.644 +/- 0.024 solar masses from Hotnisky et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-6303 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3977 +/- 59 K from Hotnisky et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6303 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Hotnisky et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6303 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-6303.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.678, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6303 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.44 dex, from Hotnisky et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6303 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.08672, from Hotnisky et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6303 (pscomppars): age 6.4 Gyr, from Hotnisky et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6303 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Hotnisky et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
